definitions.explanation: Having a smooth, shiny surface or appearance. Used for hair, skin, lacquerware, and similar objects.
Having a vibrant, attractive appearance that suggests health, youth, or sensual beauty.

examples.japanese: {艶|つや}やかな⟦{黒|くろ}い→黒い：00588_kuroi⟧⟦{漆器|しっき}→漆器：13329_shikki⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦シャンプー→シャンプー：04507_shanpuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{艶|つや}やか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Using this shampoo makes your hair glossy.

examples.japanese: {艶|つや}やかな⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧。
⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{艶|つや}やかだった。
examples.english: She looked radiant in her kimono.
I was captivated by the dancer performing alluringly on the stage.

notes:
Derived from ⟦{艶|つや}→艶：03893_tsuya⟧ (gloss, luster) with the suffix や⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ forming a na-adjective. Describes a quality of smooth, healthy shine on surfaces or an attractive, vibrant appearance in people. Often used in beauty, fashion, and literary contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {艶|つや}やかな⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧: glossy hair
- {艶|つや}やかな⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧: lustrous skin
- {艶|つや}やかな⟦{唇|くちびる}→唇：03903_kuchibiru⟧: glossy lips
- {艶|つや}やか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{輝|かがや}く→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧: to shine lustrously

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {艶|あで}やか: glamorous, bewitching — emphasizes alluring, sensual beauty rather than physical glossiness; read with あ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ not つや
- ⟦つやつや→つやつや：05888_tsuyatsuya⟧: shiny, glossy — an onomatopoeic word describing the same physical shine but in a more casual, everyday way
- ⟦{鮮|あざ}やか→鮮やか：05702_azayaka⟧: vivid, brilliant — describes brightness of color rather than glossy texture
